**DEDICATION**

To the great minds who paved the way before us—those upon whose shoulders we stand as we walk the path of knowledge and reason.  
And to our families, especially **our parents**, whose unwavering support, prayers, and patience played the greatest role in guiding us to this milestone. To the engineers and doctors who have guided us with wisdom and patience throughout our journey, we extend our heartfelt appreciation.

We also express our deepest gratitude to our supervisor, **Dr. Diana Rbehat**, who spared no effort in encouraging us, inspiring us to give our best, and providing our team with invaluable insights and guidance that elevated our work at every stage.
